promptHelp.consoleWriteNote: Console command: argv = connection.flags + shell-split(prompt). No --allowedTools or system prompt is sent.
promptHelp.heading: Placeholders supported in prompt_template:

placeholders.artifactBase: The artifact file name without its extension, e.g. "design".
placeholders.artifactName: The full artifact file name, e.g. "design.md".
placeholders.selection: The text the user highlighted in the artifact viewer.
placeholders.selectionLines: The line(s) in the source file matching the selected region, e.g. "12" or "12-15".

promptHelp.selectionNote: (only has a value when the action has the "Text selection" attach point and is run from a selection — empty when run from the title toolbar)
promptHelp.writeNote: Note: for an action to actually change a file, the prompt must ask the agent to OVERWRITE the file (using the Write tool) — the runner's stdout is NOT written back to the file.
